name: @frankkramer-lab/redcap-toolkit
description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript toolkit for parsing, validating, and round-tripping REDCap Data Dictionary CSV files across one or more questionnaires/instruments. Unaffiliated third-party project; REDCap is a registered trademark of Vanderbilt University.

scripts.test:unit: tsc && TEST_FILES=$(find dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort) && if [ -n "$TEST_FILES" ]; then node --test $TEST_FILES; else echo 'No unit tests to run'; fi
scripts.eval:all: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const pkg = require('./package.json'); const commit = execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', { cwd: process.cwd(), encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); const dirty = execSync('git status --porcelain', { cwd: process.cwd(), encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); console.log('Git commit: ' + commit); console.log('Package version: ' + pkg.version); console.log('Published npm version must equal package.json version before the numbers are used in the paper.'); if (dirty && process.env.ALLOW_DIRTY !== '1') { console.error('Working tree is dirty; re-run with ALLOW_DIRTY=1 to mark reports dirty.'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run build && npm run evaluate_test && npm run roundtrip_diff && npm run check:roundtrip && npm run precision && npm run precision_report

author: Florian J. Auer
